cause: Q2'24 revenue $13.5M +54% YoY (4th consecutive quarter above $10M), bookings backlog roughly doubled YoY to $723M with ~7-year avg contract duration, FY24 guidance raised to 'exceed $80M' and FY25 (post-Amelia acquisition) to 'exceed $150M', gross margin 63% (67% ex acquisition amortization)
quality: 经营性持续但仍未盈利: backlog growth and multi-year guidance raise (with Amelia deal framed as accretive by H2 2025) are structurally positive, though the business remains loss-making and cash-burning
reason: Unlike the Feb-24 print (which came after an extreme 314%/21-day run and was judged a chase), this jump comes after a much more modest 21-day/63-day prior move (+2.76%/+8.32%), so less exhaustion risk. The backlog doubling and guidance raises are real and the company holds $201M cash with zero debt, giving runway. Still speculative: H1'24 operating cash burn was $40.4M and the business is not yet near breakeven, so this is a growth-story bet, not a clean quality beat.
